mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(o.order_time) BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN '早餐' WHEN HOUR(o.order_time) BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '午餐' ELSE '晚餐' END as mealPeriod, COUNT(*) as percentage FROM orders o JOIN order_detail od ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.status != 6 GROUP BY mealPeriod

SELECT od.name as dishName, SUM(od.amount) as totalSpend FROM order_detail od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.status != 6 GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY totalSpend DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT od.name as dishName, SUM(od.number) as totalCount FROM order_detail od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.status != 6 GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.amount AS maxAmount, ( SELECT od.name FROM order_detail od WHERE od.order_id = o.id ORDER BY od.number DESC, od.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS maxDishName FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.status != 6 ORDER BY o.amount DESC, o.order_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT od.name AS topDishName, SUM(COALESCE(od.number, 1)) AS topDishCount FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} AND o.pay_status = 1 AND o.status != 6 GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY topDishCount DESC, od.name ASC LIMIT 1
